name: fireline-examples-discovery
description: Discovery-only external consumer examples for Fireline managed-agent surfaces.

scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run check:surface
scripts.dev:next-basic: fireline runtime dev -- pnpm run dev:next-basic:next --
scripts.dev:next-open-cloudflare: fireline runtime dev -- pnpm run dev:next-open-cloudflare:next --
scripts.dev:tanstack-shaped: fireline runtime dev -- pnpm run dev:tanstack-shaped:vite
scripts.smoke:inline-js-local: fireline runtime dev --launch-control-stream fireline-examples-control -- tsx examples/01-inline-js-local/run.ts
scripts.smoke:curl-shell-raw-http: fireline runtime dev --launch-control-stream fireline-curl-shell-raw-control -- sh examples/07-curl-shell-raw-http/run.sh
scripts.smoke:deno: fireline runtime dev --launch-control-stream fireline-deno-control -- deno run --node-modules-dir=manual --allow-net=127.0.0.1 --allow-env=FIRELINE_ENDPOINT,FIRELINE_DURABLE_STREAMS_URL,FIRELINE_DAEMON_URL,DENO_EXAMPLE_TENANT_ID,DENO_EXAMPLE_RUN_ID,DENO_EXAMPLE_ATTEMPT_ID,DENO_EXAMPLE_PROMPT,NODE_ENV examples/16-deno/main.ts
scripts.smoke:python-raw-http: fireline runtime dev --launch-control-stream fireline-python-raw-control -- python3 examples/09-python-raw-http/run.py
scripts.smoke:rust-raw-http: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-/tmp/fireline-mono-oet-29-3-9-target} fireline runtime dev --launch-control-stream fireline-rust-raw-control -- cargo run --quiet --manifest-path examples/10-rust-raw-http/Cargo.toml
scripts.smoke:go-raw-http: fireline runtime dev --launch-control-stream fireline-go-raw-control -- go run examples/15-go-raw-http/main.go
scripts.smoke:acp-registry-chat: fireline runtime dev --launch-control-stream fireline-acp-registry-chat-control -- tsx examples/17-acp-registry-chat/src/run.ts
scripts.smoke:middleware-stack: fireline runtime dev --launch-control-stream fireline-middleware-stack-control -- tsx examples/18-middleware-stack/src/run.ts
scripts.smoke:vercel-edge-runtime: fireline runtime dev --launch-control-stream fireline-vercel-edge-control -- sh -c "pnpm run build:vercel-edge-runtime >/dev/null && tsx examples/13-vercel-edge-runtime/src/run-local.ts"
scripts.smoke:bun: fireline runtime dev --launch-control-stream fireline-bun-control -- bun examples/14-bun/src/run.ts
